basic_details.job_title: NCDC Private Secretary Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), under the Directorate General of Health Services, Government of India, is filling one post of Private Secretary, Group 'B' (Gazetted), in Level-7 (44900-142400) of the pay matrix, on deputation basis at NCDC, Delhi. Only officers under the Central Government may apply. Applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-II) may be forwarded to the Director, National Centre for Disease Control, 22-Sham Nath Marg, Delhi-110054, within two months from the date of issue of the advertisement, which appeared in Employment News dated 7-13 November 2026 -

content_sections.heading: NCDC Private Secretary at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: National Centre for Disease Control (Directorate General of Health Services), Government of India
Central Govt. officer holding an analogous post, or Stenographer in Level-6 or equivalent with 5 years' service in the grade
National Centre for Disease Control, 22-Sham Nath Marg, Delhi-110054
Post, in the Annexure-II proforma, forwarded to the Director, NCDC
Within two months from the date of issue of the advertisement (about 7 January 2027 )

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The Annexure-II proforma asks for these details from the candidate: Name (in block letters), date of birth and educational qualifications Service to which the candidate belongs Complete official address with telephone number Present post held, date since held on a regular basis, present pay, and scale of pay/pay level Experience, and telephone/mobile number Date, place and signature of the candidate The proforma also has a part "For use in the Applicant's Office", which the candidate's present office completes with signature, designation and office seal. It certifies that the details given by the applicant have been verified and found correct, records the date the applicant submitted the application, states the period covered by the APAR folder, and confirms that the Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificates are enclosed.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The post is open to officers under the Central Govt.: (i) Holding analogous posts, or (ii) Working as Stenographer in Level-6 (35,400-1,12,400) or equivalent with 5 years' service in the grade. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the proforma only asks candidates to list their educational qualifications. The notice does not mention an age limit. For the exact eligibility of the post, refer to Annexure-I of the official notification. Pay: Level-7 (44900-142400) of the pay matrix. The appointment on deputation, pay and deputation (duty) allowance will be regulated in accordance with the terms and conditions in DoP&T OM No.2/29/91-Estt.(Pay II) dated 05.01.1994, as amended from time to time. The period of deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 3 years.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Private Secretary Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the duties of the Private Secretary as follows: To provide stenographic assistance to the officers of the rank of Additional Director/Director. To keep the Officer free from the worries of a routine by mailing correspondence, filling papers, making appointments, arranging meetings and collecting information. To be skilled in human relations. To earn the trust of his/her Officer for being entrusted with confidential and secret papers. To be popular with persons who come in contact with the boss officially, who are helpful to the boss, or who have dealings with the boss in officially professional matters.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: While forwarding the applications, the following information/certificates in respect of the applicants may also be furnished: Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance Certificate Attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years

content_sections.text: Applications of candidates who cannot be relieved immediately need not be forwarded. Selected candidates will not be permitted to withdraw their candidature later.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCDC Private Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Private Secretary, Group 'B' (Gazetted), at the National Centre for Disease Control, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NCDC Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: Applications may be forwarded within two months from the date of issue of the advertisement, which appeared in Employment News dated 7-13 November 2026 - about 7 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the NCDC Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central Govt. holding analogous posts, or working as Stenographer in Level-6 (35,400-1,12,400) or equivalent with 5 years' service in the grade, are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NCDC Private Secretary?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-7 (44900-142400) of the pay matrix. Pay and deputation (duty) allowance are regulated by DoP&T OM No.2/29/91-Estt.(Pay II) dated 05.01.1994, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the NCDC Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II and have it forwarded to the Director, National Centre for Disease Control, 22-Sham Nath Marg, Delhi-110054, along with the certificates and APAR copies the notice names.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: An Integrity Certificate, a Vigilance Clearance Certificate and attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years may be furnished with the application.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NCDC Private Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is filled on deputation basis, and the period of deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 3 years.

faq.question: Q8. Can a selected candidate withdraw from the NCDC Private Secretary selection?
faq.answer: No, selected candidates will not be permitted to withdraw their candidature later. Applications of candidates who cannot be relieved immediately need not be forwarded.
